description: This Java class 'SQLProcessor' provides utility functions to facilitate database access, including connection management, executing queries and updates, handling transactions, and setting prepared statement parameters within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SQLProcessor
classes.description: A utility class for managing database connections, executing SQL statements, handling transactions, and setting parameters in prepared statements within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if in manual transaction mode.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if in manual transaction mode or sets rollback only if in auto-commit mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes open resources such as ResultSet, PreparedStatement, and Connection, and commits if in manual transaction mode.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection from the TransactionFactoryLoader, sets auto-commit to false, and manages transaction state.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with optional result set type and concurrency, fetch size, and max rows.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the prepared statement as a query and returns the ResultSet.

methods.name: executeQuery (with SQL string)
methods.description: Prepares and executes a query based on the provided SQL string.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes the prepared statement as an update and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: executeUpdate (with SQL string)
methods.description: Executes an SQL update statement directly.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the cursor in the current ResultSet.

methods.name: execQuery
methods.description: Executes a query and processes each row with a callback function.

methods.name: setValue (generic handler)
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the prepared statement using a JdbcValueHandler.

methods.name: setValue (String)
methods.description: Sets a String parameter in the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue (Timestamp)
methods.description: Sets a Timestamp parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Time)
methods.description: Sets a Time parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Date)
methods.description: Sets a Date parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Integer)
methods.description: Sets an Integer parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Long)
methods.description: Sets a Long parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Float)
methods.description: Sets a Float parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Double)
methods.description: Sets a Double parameter.

methods.name: setValue (BigDecimal)
methods.description: Sets a BigDecimal parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Boolean)
methods.description: Sets a Boolean parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Object)
methods.description: Sets an Object parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Blob)
methods.description: Sets a Blob parameter.

methods.name: setValue (Clob)
methods.description: Sets a Clob parameter.

methods.name: setBinaryStream
methods.description: Serializes an object and sets it as a binary stream parameter.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array as a parameter.

methods.name: executeBatch
methods.description: Executes batch updates and returns the total number of affected rows.

methods.name: addBatch
methods.description: Adds the current set of parameters to the batch for execution.
